name: webradio-plugin
description: Search and discover internet radio stations worldwide via the free Radio Browser API.
long_description: Search over 30,000 internet radio stations by name, country, or genre. Get stream URLs, station details, and top stations by popularity. Uses the free, open-source Radio Browser API — no API key required.

tools.name: radio_search
tools.description: Search radio stations by name, country, or genre tag

tools.name: radio_get_station
tools.description: Get station details and stream URL by UUID

tools.name: radio_top_stations
tools.description: Get the most popular radio stations worldwide
